this paper has presented a dynamic contact model of large-scale forging grippers, the dynamic equations are formulated, the solution of dynamic equations is finished by Adams, and the driving forces and contact forces are calculated.
the contact model with spring and damping is more suitable for the analysis of dynamic contact forces for forging manipulators.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the dynamic model for forging manipulator grippers can be established by the contact model, and the contact model with spring damper system is more reasonable than that with point contact.
the contact forces are not the same as the gripping force, and they are related with the contact status, the deformation of the tongs and work-piece, and the driving force.
the dynamic contact forces of the forging manipulator grippers are calculated based on the spring-damper contact model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the dynamic contact forces are not the same with the static contact forces, which is helpful for the analysis and design of the gripper.
the dynamic contact model with spring and damper system can be used to calculate the contact forces of large-scale forging tongs.
the dynamic contact force is the main factor that affects the dynamic response of the workpiece, and the dynamic response of forging workpiece is mainly affected by the dynamic contact force.
